rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the act or event of placing a person's remains in the ground.

example.english: After the funeral, the remains will be placed in the ground for burial.
example.traditional: 葬禮完咗，遺體就會下葬。
example.jyutping: zong3 lai5 jyun4 zo2 wai4 tai2 zau6 wui5 haa6 zong3
